originalTitle: Wall St futures fall as Nvidia slides on report of possible CEO ouster
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures fell on Wednesday evening as Nvidia shares tumbled in extended trading following a report that the chipmaker's board was preparing to remove Chief Executive Jensen Huang, raising concerns about stability at the company at the centre of the AI boom.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures fell on Wednesday evening as Nvidia shares tumbled in extended trading following a report that the chipmaker's board was preparing to remove Chief Executive Jensen Huang, raising concerns about stability at the company at the centre of the AI boom.

Nasdaq 100 Futures dropped 1% to 28,205.75 points by 19:25 ET (00:25 GMT). S&P 500 Futures fell 0.4% to 7,608.75 points, while Dow Jones Futures traded flat at 52,577.0 points.

Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) fell more than 8% in after-hours trading after The Wall Street Journal reported that the company's board was preparing to consider Huang's future, with a meeting potentially taking place as soon as Wednesday.

The New York Times separately reported that Huang had an extramarital relationship with a company executive who reports to him. Over the weekend, Huang admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman alleged to be a spy.

The report added to mounting uncertainty surrounding Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has led its transformation into the world's dominant supplier of artificial intelligence processors.

The potential departure of Huang would represent a significant leadership shake-up for Nvidia, whose fortunes have been closely tied to its co-founder's strategic direction and relationships with major technology companies and customers.

Wednesday's after-hours decline contrasted with a strong performance during the regular session, when U.S. stocks rallied as improving sentiment around artificial intelligence infrastructure spending lifted technology shares.

The S&P 500 gained 1.3%, the NASDAQ Composite advanced 1.6% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.5%. Nvidia shares climbed 2.9% during regular trading.

AI cloud infrastructure provider CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV) surged 24.7% after forecasting profitability in 2028, helping ease concerns about the sustainability of heavy investment in AI infrastructure.

Beyond technology stocks, investors were monitoring developments in Washington following the U.S. midterm elections, with Democrats' gains adding another layer of uncertainty around the political and regulatory outlook.

Oil prices also remained in focus after renewed uncertainty over U.S.-Iran negotiations. Brent crude settled 1.4% higher at $92.76 a barrel.

chineseTitle: 英伟达因首席执行官可能被罢免的报道而下跌，华尔街期货下跌
chineseSummary: Investing.com——周三晚间，美国股指期货下跌，因有报道称该芯片制造商董事会正准备罢免首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)，英伟达股价在盘后交易中暴跌，引发了人们对这家处于人工智能繁荣中心的公司稳定性的担忧。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——周三晚间，美国股指期货下跌，因有报道称该芯片制造商董事会正准备罢免首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)，英伟达股价在盘后交易中暴跌，引发了人们对这家处于人工智能繁荣中心的公司稳定性的担忧。

截至美国东部时间 19:25（格林威治标准时间 00:25），纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 1%，至 28,205.75 点。标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.4%，至 7,608.75 点，而道琼斯期货则持平于 52,577.0 点。

据《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达董事会正准备考虑黄仁勋的未来，并可能最快于周三召开会议，此后，英伟达 (NASDAQ:NVDA) 在盘后交易中下跌超过 8%。

《纽约时报》另外报道称，黄与一名向他汇报的公司高管存在婚外关系。周末，黄承认与被指控为间谍的中国女商人爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)有染。

该报告增加了围绕黄仁勋的越来越大的不确定性。黄仁勋于 1993 年共同创立了 Nvidia，并领导该公司转型为全球主要的人工智能处理器供应商。

黄仁勋的潜在离职将代表英伟达领导层的重大改组，英伟达的命运与其联合创始人的战略方向以及与主要科技公司和客户的关系密切相关。

周三盘后的下跌与常规交易期间的强劲表现形成鲜明对比，当时美国股市上涨，因为围绕人工智能基础设施支出的情绪改善提振了科技股。

标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1.3%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨 1.6%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.5%。 Nvidia 股价在常规交易中上涨 2.9%。

AI云基础设施提供商CoreWeave（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）在预测2028年盈利后股价飙升24.7%，有助于缓解人们对AI基础设施大量投资可持续性的担忧。

除了科技股之外，投资者还在关注美国中期选举后华盛顿的事态发展，民主党的上涨给政治和监管前景增添了另一层不确定性。

在美伊谈判再次出现不确定性后，油价也仍然是焦点。布伦特原油收涨 1.4%，至每桶 92.76 美元。
